summary: Reproduced and fix confirmed on a synthetic checkpoint. With identical random weights that include q_norm and k_norm tensors, a forward pass with use_qk_norm true gave logits exactly equal to the pass with it false at 875e503e84dd and at the fix parent f45eb4ce2090 (maximum absolute difference 0.0), so the option was ignored with no error. At the fix 91c7cc41881c the two passes differed (maximum absolute logit difference about 0.083).
what_ran: repro.py generates a 2-layer random CohereForCausalLM checkpoint (hidden size 256, 4 heads) in two directories differing only in use_qk_norm, then loads each with the unmodified Config.from_directory and Model.from_config on GPU 1 and compares Model.forward logits for one 24-token random input.
limits: The checkpoint is random and generated by the script; no real Command-R+ weights were used, because they are far larger than this worker's limit. The test shows the option is ignored before the fix and changes the output after it. It does not show that the fixed normalization matches a reference implementation. Unquantized weights only.
